parsed.explanation: The combined regime is High Risk. Entry screening treats any document/appearance discrepancy as possible wilful misrepresentation, permitting refusal, stranding and even lifetime ineligibility; foreign governments issued advisories after detentions. Inside this state, statute mandates birth-sex facility use, bars trans women from shelters, places inmates by birth sex and criminalises gender-expressive performance; immigration custody shows beatings, forced labour and sexual abuse. Panic defences persist and the state hate-crime statute omits gender identity, though a 2019 chief-prosecutor opinion and the national hate-crime statute provide partial recourse, courts have enjoined some measures, and no execution or status-criminalisation pathway is documented.

entry_documents.exposure: Officers instructed to refuse cases with document/sex discrepancies and weigh fraud findings carrying permanent ineligibility; passports reported confiscated; detentions of neighbouring citizens prompted foreign advisories.
entry_documents.protection: Fraud finding requires four elements, is never automatic, and limited waivers exist; litigation against the marker policy pending.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-issued documents meeting national screening rules; discretion at post decides refusal versus admission.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National custody policies mandating hair-cutting, hormone withdrawal and psychiatric substitution; immigration detainees report forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and sexual abuse; state statute mandates birth-sex prison placement.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Some executive orders enjoined; consular/legal access not documented for trans detainees.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry-stage screening can feed detention, where placement follows birth sex regardless of state protection.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: 2026 state Act requires birth-sex facility use, bars trans women from shelters; 2019 statute defines identity-congruent bathroom use as indecent exposure; criminal trespass exposure in some jurisdictions.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Sign-posting rule struck down 2022; school bathroom ban in litigation.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State facility law operates alongside national restrictions on single-sex facilities funding.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care barred for minors, with civil penalties for assisting adults and providers; 2026 shelter exclusion; adult HRT import/refill practice undocumented.
care_services.protection: Adult visitor care refusal remedy not documented; national care rules in litigation.
care_services.interaction: Travelling with a trans minor risks the assistance provisions; adult care access unresolved.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Counterterrorism strategy names 'radically pro-transgender' groups as prioritised targets; schools must out students; drag ban upheld with criminal penalties.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Hate-crime statute covers gender identity nationally; 2019 chief-prosecutor opinion allows gender-based sentencing enhancement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State criminal performance ban enforced by local police within the national threat-framing climate.

minors_guardians.exposure: Care ban upheld 2025, regret suits against parents, $25,000 actions, penalties for assisting minors, school outing mandates, sports exclusion by birth sex.
minors_guardians.protection: Some school directives enjoined; litigation ongoing.
minors_guardians.interaction: A guardian travelling with a trans minor enters the assistance-penalty and outing regime directly.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented pattern of assaults, refusal of service and police indifference (2021 reporting); panic defence available; hate-crime statute omits gender identity; killing rate figure is an undercount floor and carries no weight.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute; municipal ordinances narrow; enforcement record thin.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Local police discretion governs whether a visitor's report is investigated.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Enforcement of 2026 facility/shelter provisions and indecent-exposure prosecutions unsourced; bathroom-law trespass arrest documented elsewhere in the country.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have struck or enjoined several measures; civil-liberties litigation ongoing.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Relief arrives slowly and does not suspend the operative facility and custody rules.

anchor_checks.comparison: That anchor is administrative exclusion with no custody harm. Here exclusion is compounded by statutory birth-sex facilities, a criminal performance ban, custodial abuse reports and fraud-based entry refusal, so this sits lower.

Comparable: birth-sex rules, arrests, prison placement and no execution pathway. This jurisdiction adds entry-stage refusal and documented immigration-custody violence but lacks documented extortion raids, so it rates near that tier.

That anchor is discretionary secondary screening with administrative refusal and no facility or custody statute. Here refusal sits alongside criminalised presentation and birth-sex custody, so it is materially worse.

That anchor shows trained border officers and enforceable appeals with brief detention. Here remedies exist on paper but the operative rules (facility exclusion, custody placement) are enforced against the traveller, so it is far below.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime combines national screening that treats sex-document discrepancy as a potential fraud, discretionary refusal and possible permanent ineligibility, with a state that mandates birth-sex facilities, shelter exclusion, birth-sex custody and criminal penalties for gender-expressive performance. Custody conditions are documented as abusive; recourse is partial (national hate-crime coverage, one chief-prosecutor opinion, courts enjoining some orders) but never suspends the facility, shelter or custody rules the traveller actually meets. No execution pathway or status criminalisation is documented, keeping it above the severe tiers, but the universality of the facility rule plus entry and custody exposures places it in the High Risk band.
